summary: Second Isaiah calls the exiles to seek the Lord, whose thoughts are higher than human thoughts.

context.title: Seek the Lord while he may be found
paragraphs: These verses close the book of consolation addressed to the exiles in Babylon. [c1]

translationNotes.summary: PENDING-NOTE-SUMMARY: the Hebrew word means designs or plans, not idle musings.
translationNotes.body: PENDING-NOTE-BODY: the noun names what someone intends to do, so the contrast is between God's purposes and ours. [c2]

claims.text: Isaiah 40-55 is addressed to the Judean exiles in Babylon.
The Hebrew noun machashavah denotes a plan or purpose.

sources.citation: Brown, Driver and Briggs, A Hebrew and English Lexicon of the Old Testament, s.v. מַחֲשָׁבָה
